verdict.rationale: USCIS's own filing-fees page offers a Fee Calculator 'to determine the exact filing fee required', so fee amounts are self-serve on uscis.gov rather than gated behind a contact form. The same page documents the payment methods: online card/ACH, and Forms G-1450 and G-1650 for mail filings. Missing for 10: no actual dollar amounts or fee schedule quoted in the evidence, no confirmation that amounts are tied to the statutory/regulatory fee rule, no independent or hands-on corroboration of the calculator's output.
